text:
ana: Thanks everyone for joining the security segment 1—dropping follow-ups and owners here so we have a single place to track.

ravi: Thanks ana. I'll own the SOC2 evidence mapping and will share a control-owner sheet by EOD Friday. :spiral_calendar: 

morgan: Quick Q: want ISO scope to align with SOC2 (prod + infra) or keep a reduced initial scope?

kelly: I recommend aligning with SOC2 prod footprint. We can exclude non-prod tools if auditors say it's low risk. Speed vs coverage tradeoff.

morgan: noted, thanks.

ravi: On KMS BYOK: yes we support customer-managed keys for Private customers. Need an onboarding checklist (grants, rotation policy, access review). @jordan can you draft the checklist and include required IAM roles?

jordan: Sure. I'll open a PR in infra. Adding current bootstrapping snippets for reference:
```bash
# create key alias
aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/rwinference-customer-<id> --target-key-id <key-id>
# grant cross-account decrypt
aws kms create-grant --key-id <key-id> --grantee-principal <service-role-arn> --operations Decrypt Encrypt
```
I'll include these and notes about key policies.

security-bot: Docs: https://docs.redwood.example/security/kms-byok & runbook https://runbooks.redwood.example/byok-onboard :link: 

ana: On audit logs: customers asked about retention/export. Hosted default retention = 90 days; Dedicated/Private can configure retention. We should expose export to Console.

morgan: Adding Console toggle + S3 export to backlog. AC: exported logs must include user id, request id, model id, timestamp, and full request/response hash for forensics.

kelly: Confirm default encryption-at-rest for logs: service KMS vs customer KMS when BYOK enabled? @ravi any clarifying notes?

ravi: Default uses service-managed KMS. If customer BYOK enabled, we can switch log buckets to customer key but need legal + infra signoff. I'll coordinate.

ana: VPC peering vs PrivateLink question from enterprise folks 1—recommendation?

jordan: Recommend PrivateLink for cross-account and minimized routing exposure. VPC peering still fine for same-org setups. I'll add a decision matrix: latency, cost, IP management, ops complexity.

ops-bot: Created task SEC-847: "SOC2 evidence mapping" assigned to ravi, due 2026-04-15.

morgan: I'll own SEC-852 "Console audit-log export" and will post ticket with ACs by Monday.

ravi: Publishing a short FAQ for customers about KMS rotation windows and expected behavior during rewraps. Draft next week.

ana: Please add owners + due dates to the shared sheet: https://sheets.redwood.example/sec-followups (columns: owner, due, status).

kelly: Will raise prioritization in Product + Security sync for next sprint. :white_check_mark: 

morgan: One more ask 1—can security share SOC2 control narratives for Platform Availability? Product wants to align SLOs.

ravi: Will attach narratives to SEC-847 by Friday.

ana: Great. If no objections I'll close this thread after tickets + sheet entries exist. Thanks everyone! :tada:
